race.comment: DIVINE JUSTICE (9) caught eyes late at the Gold Coast last start when flashing home into third over this trip after being awkwardly away. Has placed five times over this trip and gets the chance to take closer order from the inside pillar. Thompson taking over signals intent. RED SAMOVAR (14) has a genuine case to rebound after being steadied twice and bumped late at Gold Coast. Shed the maiden tag in dominant style here three back with strong subsequent form around her. Maloney's booking is a good push. HALF MOON ROO (17) brings winning form, taking out a BM55 here last time, but the rise from 1200m to 1400m is a query. CAISHEN (7) couldn't get the job done as fav when resuming at Lismore but is a likely improver that deserves safe keeping.
